verdict.rationale: Kino documents agent access through a desktop MCP server and cloud agents that install Kino, but nothing in the evidence describes issuing API keys or tokens, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones. Credential scoping is a fair question for an agent-integrated SaaS product, so the absence of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
